item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description:
Consumption

Can cats eat cannabis leaves?

Yes. Leaves are full of nutrients and some cats seem to like them. There is no harm in cats eating your fan leaves.

Why do I get the munchies?

Cannabinoids stimulate the release of a hunger molecule called “ghrelin” . Also food tastes better!

Edibles vs. Smoking

When you inhale cannabis, you are inhaling Delta-9 THC, and goes from lungs to blood stream, so the effects are very quick.

item.title: Pests
item.description:
Pests are an issue that plague all growers. Like most things, an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure. Once an infestation gets out of control, it can often be hard to recover.

Common Types of Pests

Aphids

Aphids love to hang out on stems and eat delicious leaves. They are tiny, soft-bodied insects that like to hang out in large groups. They generally amass on stems, or under leaves.
